title: Client Advisory Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 YESTE Migration \& Education Consulting specializes in Australian visa, migration, and education services for skilled professionals, healthcare workers, students, and businesses. The team provides expert guidance on a wide range of visa categories, including skilled migration, employer\-sponsored visas, student visas, partner visas, and subclasses 407 and 482\. The company also supports businesses, particularly in healthcare, with sponsorship and compliance solutions. In education consulting, YESTE assists international students in selecting courses and institutions, managing enrollment processes, and facilitating visa approvals through strong partnerships with Australian universities, TAFEs, and private colleges. Led by MARA\-registered migration agent Maria Baby, with over 3,000 successful visa applications, the firm is committed to professionalism, integrity, and personalized service.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Client Advisory Executive is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kerala, India. This role involves advising prospective clients on Australian migration and education pathways, explaining visa options, eligibility criteria, and application processes in clear and accurate terms. The executive will conduct initial consultations, gather client information, coordinate documentation, and liaise with the migration team to ensure applications are complete and compliant. Day\-to\-day tasks include responding to inquiries via phone, email, and in person, maintaining client records in the CRM system, and following up to guide clients through each stage of their journey. The role also involves supporting education counseling activities, participating in outreach or information sessions, and contributing to continuous improvements in client service standards.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong client advisory and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex migration and education processes clearly and confidently.
* Customer service and relationship\-management skills, with a focus on empathy, professionalism, and building long\-term trust with diverse clients.
* Organizational and administrative skills for handling documentation, managing appointments, and maintaining accurate client records and follow\-ups.
* Analytical and problem\-solving abilities to assess client profiles, identify suitable visa or education options, and address application challenges.
* Proficiency in basic office software and CRM tools; comfortable working with digital records, email communication, and online application platforms.
* Ability to work effectively in an on\-site team environment in Kerala, India, with a proactive and learning\-oriented mindset.
* Relevant experience in migration consulting, education counseling, international student services, or related advisory roles is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Business, Administration, Social Sciences, Education, or a related discipline preferred.
* Fluency in English and local languages (such as Malayalam or Hindi) is highly beneficial for effective client interaction.

title: IoT Architect
description:

title: Tender Executive
description:
Job Description – Tender Executive
   


**Position Title:** 
 Tender Executive
   




**Department:** 
 Tender
   

**Minimum Qualification:** 
 B.Tech / Diploma / Master’s Degree
   

**Minimum Work Experience:** 
 0–4 years in E\-Tendering, GEM (bidding and price matching), and Tender Management
   

  

 Role Overview
   


 The Tender Executive is responsible for the comprehensive management of the tender process, from initial inquiry to final order acceptance and post\-tender activities. This role demands strong knowledge of tender procedures, market dynamics, and efficient data management to ensure competitive bidding and successful contract awards.
   

  




 Key Responsibilities
   

* **Tender Identification \& Sorting** 
  




	+ Screen and sort tenders / GEM enquiries.
	+ Share relevant opportunities with concerned departments/personnel.
* **Bidding \& Auction Participation** 
  




	+ Actively participate in tender and reverse auction processes.
	+ Identify and apply relevant GEM filters to optimize search and participation.
* **Order Processing \& Price Management** 
  




	+ Process accepted orders efficiently and accurately.
	+ Perform detailed price calculations and workouts to ensure profitability and compliance.
* **Bid Management** 
  




	+ Manage the entire bidding process, including reverse auctions (RA).
	+ Ensure seller information and updates are current and accurate.
* **Data Analysis \& Competitive Review** 
  




	+ Conduct thorough analysis of comparison data.
	+ Identify competitive advantages and areas for improvement in future bids.
* **Catalogue \& Product Management** 
  




	+ Maintain and update product catalogues.
	+ Apply appropriate filters for Level 1 (L1\) comparisons and strategic bidding.
* **Portal Management** 
  




	+ Ensure real\-time updates of stock availability and pricing on the GEM Portal.


 Skills \& Competencies
   

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in GEM portal operations and tender management systems.
* Attention to detail with excellent organizational skills.
* Ability to work under deadlines and manage multiple tenders simultaneously.
* Effective communication and coordination skills across departments.


 Requirements
   

  

 \- Conduct continuous research on tender opportunities, industry trends, and competitor activities to identify and evaluate potential avenues for business growth.
   

 \- Maintain comprehensive and accurate records of all tender\-related documentation, ensuring strict compliance with company policies, legal regulations, and tender specifications.
   

 \- Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams (e.g., sales, technical, finance, logistics) to gather essential information and facilitate seamless tender execution.
   

 \- Perform detailed analyses of both successful and unsuccessful bids to extract best practices and pinpoint areas for procedural and strategic improvement.
   

 \- Assist in managing and nurturing relationships with key clients and relevant government entities involved in tender processes.
   

 \- Prepare and deliver regular, in\-depth reports on tender status, outcomes, and market intelligence for management review and strategic decision\-making.
   

 \- Proactively identify, propose, and implement enhancements to the tender management process to improve efficiency, compliance, and success rates.

title: FAAS -Global Treasury Services -Manager
description:
Locations: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, McLean, New York, Philadelphia, San Francisco, San Jose, Seattle, Tampa, Miami, Hoboken
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 Our Global Treasury Advisory Services team is a dedicated and market\-leading national practice, supported by treasury professionals in a diverse range of areas. Whether it’s for public or private business, financial services organizations, government agencies or not\-for\-profit organizations, we’re always ready with tailored treasury insights our clients can rely on, every time. As a Treasury Manager you’ll play a leading role in that goal, driving growth and managing delivery teams using your treasury process experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 It’s a highly collaborative global network, where resources, methodologies, tools and trends are constantly updated and shared to develop simple answers to complex treasury challenges. What’s more, you’ll integrate seamlessly with other EY functions to effectively provide for our clients, so you can expect to build relationships with contacts across the business. We have a broad range of capabilities to assist clients with risk management, funding and capital management, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting and other financial analytics, Treasury technology, post\-merger integration, organizational design, cash management, and finance transformation.
   

  

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You’re likely to balance your time between personally executing client engagements, developing our business and processes, and managing a varied pipeline. That will mean working on new projects, as well as extensions for existing products, so you’ll be actively influencing a range of client relationships. We’ll also look to you to coach, support, and manage internal resources and demonstrate professionalism while working in the client environment. You will be expected to provide supervision and mentoring to staff and serve as point person for technical questions. It’s a strategic role in a rapidly growing area, where you’ll use your treasury and corporate finance knowledge and experience, as well as your understanding of our products, services and colleagues to further expand our market share, expand our solution capability, and deliver exemplary execution on client engagements. Specific responsibilities would include, but not be limited to:
   

  

* Lead and manage Treasury engagements as a senior team member to include project and resource planning, budget management, execution of work plans and client relationship management and ensure products/deliverables meet contract/work plan specifications and deadlines
* Lead the proposal development process and participate in pursuit team for prospective treasury engagements, support and lead business development and practice development initiatives
* Maintain a strong client focus by being responsive to client requests and developing/maintaining productive working relationships with client personnel.
* Collaborate with the partner and client to determine a strategy that appropriately addresses risk and manages client expectations relating to deliverables, understanding the client’s industry, key performance drivers, business trends and industry developments
* Develop and maintain strong networks, both internally and externally, and work with other service lines in providing an integrated service delivery
* Support the development of expanded client solutions in data and analysis, leveraging emerging technology and advanced analytics to deliver key insights to clients


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Handling the proposal development process for prospective treasury engagement, while supporting in the development of new services and strategies
* Supporting engagement planning, budgeting, execution and management
* Creating process flows and design documents, workshops and tools
* Overseeing end\-user training and support
* Building long\-term relationships with our clients to discover their unique goals, ambitions and needs
* Maintaining an up\-to\-date understanding of tools, practices, and trends in a wide range of areas, including in\-house cash, bank structure, communications, account G/L structure, intercompany processes, liquidity planning and payments processing. Strong analytical and technical skills
* Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* Achieved, or be working towards a professional designation, such as CTP, CFA, CPA, FRM
* A proven record of problem solving and analytical thinking within a global corporate treasury or consulting business
* Advanced skills and experience with: Treasury organizational structure and transformation, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting, analytics, liquidity management, cash and bank relationship management, international treasury centers, debt and investment management, due diligence, governance and controls, carve outs, and hedge accounting
* The confidence to train and mentor junior colleagues, providing the knowledge, skills and opportunities they need to excel
* Excellent sales and influencing skills, and the ability to present credibly to senior clients and colleagues
* Valid passport required; willingness and ability to travel internationally
* The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary
* Access to reliable transportation to/from the EY office and client sites. A driver’s license is strongly recommended as ride share and public transportation options may not be available in all locations


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A master’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, financial engineering, economics, information technology, information systems, engineering or another relevant discipline
* Certified Treasury Professional qualification
* CFA designation (or CFA candidate)
* Consulting experience on complex projects
* System selection and implementation experience


**What We Look For**
 We’re interested in natural problem\-solvers and leaders, with proven project management and engagement experience. You’ll have the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements, as well as the ability to communicate complex information simply and effectively to audiences from all backgrounds. If you’re a global treasury professional looking to further your career as part of a highly collaborative team, this role is for you.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.
   

  

* We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
* 
+ New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $154,000 to $256,700
+ Bay Area California offices – $160,500 to $267,400
+ All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $128,400 to $235,300

* Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
* Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.


**Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.**
* To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six\-month period.
* EY accepts applications for this position on an on\-going basis.
* For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
* At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
   

  

 All in to shape the future with confidence.
   

  

 EY provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law.
   

  

 EY is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities including veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and either need assistance applying online or need to request an accommodation during any part of the application process, please call 1\-800\-EY\-HELP3, select Option 2 for candidate related inquiries, then select Option 1 for candidate queries and finally select Option 2 for candidates with an inquiry which will route you to EY’s Talent Shared Services Team (TSS) or email the TSS at ssc.customersupport@ey.com.

title: Customer Relationship Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 New Lights LLP delivers premium lighting solutions that blend style, quality, and innovation for residential and commercial spaces. The company offers a wide range of modern decorative and architectural lighting designed to enhance interiors and exteriors. Serving customers across Kerala, New Lights LLP partners with trusted brands such as ACE Gen Next Lighting to ensure reliable and high\-performing products. Team members contribute to creating brighter, more engaging environments for homes and businesses while supporting a growing, design\-focused organization.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Customer Relationship Executive is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ernakulam. This role focuses on managing customer interactions, responding to inquiries, and providing product information and recommendations for lighting solutions. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include handling walk\-in and existing clients, maintaining records of customer communication, coordinating with the sales and operations teams, and following up on orders and deliveries. The executive will also support after\-sales service, gather customer feedback, and help resolve issues to ensure positive long\-term relationships. The role requires consistent on\-site presence to collaborate with colleagues and engage directly with customers.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong customer service and relationship management skills, with the ability to handle inquiries, feedback, and issue resolution professionally.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, including clear verbal and written communication with customers and internal teams.
* Basic sales and negotiation abilities, with an interest in promoting lighting solutions and supporting revenue growth.
* Organizational and time\-management skills, including maintaining accurate records and managing multiple customer requests.
* Comfort with using computers and business tools (e.g., email, spreadsheets, CRM or sales tracking software).
* Ability to work on\-site in Ernakulam and collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Prior experience in customer\-facing roles; experience in lighting, retail, or home improvement sectors is an advantage.
* Minimum educational qualification: higher secondary or a diploma; a bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field is preferred.

title: Service Now Senior Technical Consultant
description:
******Company Overview******
 Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
   

  

 Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
   

  

******Job Overview******
 Milestone Technologies is actively seeking a Senior ServiceNow Technical Consultant to join their team on a full\-time basis. The company is looking for experienced ServiceNow delivery experts with a strong background in assisting organizations in adopting service management and asset management best practices and optimizing them on the ServiceNow platform. The successful candidate will possess expertise in service management/asset management process design and ServiceNow configuration and development.
   

  

******Responsibilities******
* Collaborate with clients to assess current state processes and tools, identify ServiceNow platform solution options, define requirements, determine integration needs, and develop comprehensive architecture and implementation plans for broad\-scope and complex projects
* Work with Milestone Technologies business development and leadership teams to scope new project opportunities and contribute to proposal development
* Lead and conduct requirements, scoping, and design workshops, ensuring thorough documentation of requirements
* Provide expert\-level support and technical mentoring to the Milestone Technologies implementation team
* Maintain a deep and comprehensive knowledge of ServiceNow's capabilities and constraints
* Stay informed about industry trends, competitors, third\-party solutions, and integrations.
* Collaborate with technical consultants, customers, and project teams to architect and design solutions that leverage native configuration opportunities
* Identify and develop opportunities to leverage ServiceNow as a platform for custom applications both within and outside of ITSM
* Deliver hands\-on configuration, development, and integration services as a senior technical member of the team, ensuring delivery assurance for all project deliverables
* Plan and coordinate all phases of testing and test acceptance, leading test remediation cycles
* Lead practice build efforts, including the development of practice intellectual property (IP)


**Skills**
* Expert\-level understanding and implementation experience with at least two of the following three ServiceNow application suites: ITOM, ITSM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, GRC/IRM, and/or SecOps
* Expert\-level understanding of ServiceNow core application UI and workflow configuration, report development, and integration components (e.g., LDAP, SSO)
* Experience leading at least three full lifecycle ServiceNow implementations.
* Minimum of 5 years experience with ServiceNow
* Advanced experience with web technologies (XML, HTML, JavaScript, Web Services, etc.)
* Excellent understanding of implementation methodologies/SDLC (e.g., Agile Scrum, Waterfall)
* Minimum of 3\+ years experience soliciting and documenting requirements and evolving these requirements into successful solutions
* Excellent interpersonal skills with experience establishing and maintaining credibility as a ServiceNow expert
* Experience and comfort in public speaking situations (IP)


******Skills******
* 8\+ years within the ITSM industry, including asset management
* 5\+ years of experience with the ServiceNow Platform
* 5\+ years of professional services/consulting experience
* Advanced level understanding of ServiceNow application UI and workflow configuration, report development, and integration components (e.g., LDAP, SSO, etc.)
* Experience in reconciling software license positions
* Integration experience, including but not limited to SCCM or other software discovery tools
* Participation in at least two full lifecycle ServiceNow implementations
* Excellent understanding of implementation methodologies/SDLC (e.g., Agile Scrum, Waterfall)
* ServiceNow Certifications for System Administrator and Certified Implementation Specialist (or commitment to attain these certifications within 90 days of hire date)


****ServiceNow Certifications Required.****
* 
+ CSA
+ CAD


**Must have a combination of multiple CIS**

+ HAM
+ SAM
+ HRSD


****Consulting Skills:****
*
